page_title: Free Screen Recorder & Screenshot App for Mac | Shotnix

summary.name: Shotnix
summary.one_liner: Shotnix is a free, open source (MIT) screen recorder and screenshot app for Apple silicon Macs that captures scrolling, annotated, and searchable screenshots and edited screen recordings with no watermark.
use_cases: Recording screen tutorials with webcam and narration
Capturing long web pages with scrolling screenshots
Creating vertical videos for TikTok, Reels, or Shorts
Extracting text from screenshots with OCR
Adding captions to screen recordings without uploading
summary.what_it_does: Shotnix takes area, window, fullscreen, all-displays, timed, and scrolling screenshots, plus OCR text capture and QR code scanning. Its screen recorder can capture system audio and microphone as separate tracks, and a webcam feed saved as its own layer that can be reshaped after recording. Recordings can be paused, edited with background music, logos, title cards, and transitions, and exported as video, GIF (10 to 24 fps), or to the clipboard. Narration is transcribed for captions on-device using Apple's speech recognition, with nothing uploaded.
notable: MIT-licensed, free with no account, time limit, or watermark
On-device captions and translation with no cloud or share links
Webcam saved as a separate layer for post-recording layout
Vertical 9:16, 4:5, and 1:1 export with cursor-following pan
caveats: Requires Apple silicon (M1 or later) and macOS 13 or newer; the official download does not run on Intel Macs
Caption translation requires macOS 15 or later
Screen recording requires macOS Screen Recording permission
